decision.reason: There are no remaining exact pruned rows to skip in the CPU fallback loop; pruned rows are already zeroed before fallback. The only exact skip/zero saving is the historical grouping/zero-fill cost around 82 ms. Skipping more rows would be approximate top-k pruning, and the relevant top2 variants already failed trajectory/correctness or performance.

The active fallback profile count equals route pruned0 count for both up and down, so pruned1 rows are already outside the CPU fallback loop.
The fused up/gate path can still report up fallback work, but the current stream/fallback counters show only retained rows remain in CPU fallback under the accepted policy.
